name: Kaito's Bedroom
layout: Small rectangular teen bedroom. Door on one short wall; window on the opposite wall above a compact desk. Bed along the long wall; shelving and a low dresser opposite the bed. Clear floor path from door to desk for staging entries and exits.
key_landmarks: Desk under the window (primary story stage)
Window with simple curtains / visible neighbourhood suggestion outside
Wall shelf or corkboard with sketches and school notices
furniture_objects: School bag hook or floor drop-zone
Sketchbooks and pencil cup on desk
visual_identifiers: Lived-in but not chaotic: paper stacks, a few posters, unfinished sketches
Warm ordinary home lighting; night scenes use lamp + window moonlight
Jacket often on chair back when not worn
Clear desk surface when ritual / Inkwell scenes require focus
camera_possibilities: Wide from doorway establishing whole room
Low angle from floor for Sumi / small Echo moments
Side profile of Kaito at desk for quiet thinking beats
continuity_constraints: Window and desk relationship must stay consistent (desk under window)
Do not relocate the door between pages without reason
Bed side should remain the same across the volume
When Sumi rests on the page, sketchbook position should match prior panel logic
Night vs day lighting must match caption/time continuity
